name: Statement 75
definition: General characteristics related to a statement which reports information.

StatementType.name: Statement Type
StatementType.definition: Indicates whether the statement is a balance only notification or if it includes missing instructions only or all instructions.

ReportingType.name: Reporting Type
ReportingType.definition: Indicates whether the statement report on account holdings for corporate action events is for single account/multiple events or multiple accounts/single event.

InstructionAggregationPeriod.name: Instruction Aggregation Period
InstructionAggregationPeriod.definition: Indicates the period of instruction details within the statement.

UpdateType.name: Update Type
UpdateType.definition: Indicates whether the report is complete or contains changes only.

ActivityIndicator.name: Activity Indicator
ActivityIndicator.definition: Indicates whether there is activity or information update reported in the statement.

NotificationDeadlinePeriod.name: Notification Deadline Period
NotificationDeadlinePeriod.definition: Period during which identification deadline has been set.
